questions.question: Skilled artisans in our community create beautiful _______, including pottery, textiles, and wooden carvings.

questions.explanation: Chọn “handicrafts”. handicrafts = đồ thủ công như gốm, vải dệt, đồ khắc gỗ.

questions.question: Do you have any tips on how _______ stronger neighborhood bonds?
questions.question_html: Do you have any tips on how _______ stronger neighborhood bonds?
questions.explanation: Đáp án “to build”. how + to V: cách làm việc gì; sau “how” dùng động từ nguyên mẫu có “to”.

questions.question: Let's discuss _______ to improve our community garden.
questions.question_html: Let's discuss _______ to improve our community garden.
questions.explanation: Đáp án “how”. discuss how to V: thảo luận cách làm việc gì.

questions.question: Do you know when _______ up for the community choir?
questions.question_html: Do you know when _______ up for the community choir?
questions.explanation: Đáp án “to sign”. when + to V: khi nào làm việc gì.

questions.question: The artisans in my village usually hand down their skills to their eldest children.
questions.question_html: The artisans in my village usually <u>hand down</u> their skills to their eldest children.
questions.explanation: “hand down” gần nghĩa nhất với “pass down”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.question: Vong, a small village in Ha Noi, is well-known for its specialty food: com (young sticky rice flakes).
questions.question_html: Vong, a small village in Ha Noi, is <u>well-known</u> for its specialty food: com (young sticky rice flakes).
questions.explanation: “well-known” gần nghĩa nhất với “famous”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.question: Care for Animals took care of thousands of homeless dogs and cats last year.
questions.question_html: Care for Animals <u>took care of</u> thousands of homeless dogs and cats last year.
questions.explanation: “took care of” gần nghĩa nhất với “looked after”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.question: Community service allows students to develop themselves.
questions.question_html: Community service <u>allows</u> students to develop themselves.
questions.explanation: “allows” gần nghĩa nhất với “permits”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.question: Local communities often work together to preserve their cultural heritage and historical landmarks.
questions.question_html: Local communities often work together to <u>preserve</u> their cultural heritage and historical landmarks.
questions.explanation: “preserve” gần nghĩa nhất với “save”. Xét nghĩa của từ/cụm từ trong ngữ cảnh câu, không chỉ dịch riêng lẻ.

questions.question: Long Hòa, a suburb of Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam, is known for its tranquil environment and close-knit community.
questions.question_html: Long Hòa, a <u>suburb</u> of Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam, is known for its tranquil environment and close-knit community.
questions.explanation: “city centre” mang nghĩa đối lập với “suburb” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.question: The local government must not neglect the maintenance of community centers.
questions.question_html: The local government must not <u>neglect</u> the maintenance of community centers.
questions.explanation: “look after” mang nghĩa đối lập với “neglect” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.question: The villagers preserve their traditional weaving techniques.
questions.question_html: The villagers <u>preserve</u> their traditional weaving techniques.
questions.explanation: “damage” mang nghĩa đối lập với “preserve” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.question: Nick likes reading books. He has a very nice voice.
questions.question_html: Nick <u>likes</u> reading books. He has a very nice voice.
questions.explanation: “hates” mang nghĩa đối lập với “likes” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.question: Lan will you join the Tutoring project because she is good at maths and English.
questions.question_html: Lan will you join the Tutoring project because she is <u>good</u> at maths and English.
questions.note: Câu gốc có lỗi diễn đạt “Lan will you join”; giữ nguyên theo tài liệu.
questions.explanation: “bad” mang nghĩa đối lập với “good” trong câu. Đây là câu hỏi tìm từ trái nghĩa.

questions.passage: I’m fascinated (1) __________ traditional handicrafts. At weekends, I usually go to Bat Trang where I was born. It’s a (2) __________ village not far from Ha Noi center. My uncle and my aunt  still live in Bat Trang and they own a big workshop there. In fact, my grandparents (3) __________ that workshop and some years ago, my uncle and my aunt (4) __________ the business because my grandparents are very old. My grandfather is a well-known artisan in the village. Every time I go there, he teaches me how (5) ______ things from clay such as pots, vase and bowls.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.question_html: What does this sign mean?

options.A: Keeping away the cheating is unnecessary.
options.B: There is a sign of cheating standing near here.
options.C: It’s important to say no to cheating after class.
options.D: Cheating in the classroom is prohibited

options_html.A: Keeping away the cheating is unnecessary.
options_html.B: There is a sign of cheating standing near here.
options_html.C: It’s important to say no to cheating after class.
options_html.D: Cheating in the classroom is prohibited

questions.explanation: Biển báo trong ảnh thể hiện: “Cheating in the classroom is prohibited”. Quan sát biểu tượng và các chữ trên biển để xác định yêu cầu/cảnh báo.
